summary: Frontend smoke + deep test of new 7-division Services accordion on Armeen HW site. All accordion criteria pass: 7 divisions render with numbers 01-07, correct data-testids, single-open behavior (aria-expanded toggles), construction open by default, Production 'Reel — Coming Soon' / 'Akan Datang' placeholder renders, EN↔BM bilingual swap works for eyebrow, titles, bullets and Reel label. Old tab-construction / tab-it testids are gone. No console errors, no React warnings. All other home sections (about, services, capabilities, portfolio, industries, certifications, leadership, contact) render. Hero uses id='top' with data-testid='hero-section'. WhatsApp FAB present (data-testid='whatsapp-fab-wrapper'). Project detail page /projects/rumah-gadang-chalet-jempol loads with full content.
critical_code_review_comments: Services.jsx clean (130 lines), proper useState accordion pattern, aria-expanded correctly toggled, uses grid-rows-[0fr]→[1fr] transition for smooth open/close.
i18n.js divisions array is well-structured; production division correctly has videoComingSoon:true flag.
Minor: clicking the currently-open division row a second time collapses it (setOpen(-1)) — this is fine UX but means accordion can have zero open rows. Acceptable for St Regis style.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Services section is a 7-row accordion using division keys: construction, electrical-mechanical, it, production, corporate-gift, ev-charger, laundry. Each has data-testid='division-<key>', toggle button 'division-toggle-<key>', and bullets 'division-<key>-bullet-0..3'. Production has special Clapperboard 'Reel — Coming Soon' card. To verify open state in Playwright reliably, query aria-expanded on the toggle button — DO NOT rely on is_visible() of nested bullets because the collapse uses grid-rows-[0fr] + overflow-hidden so child bounding boxes still report intrinsic dimensions. Lang toggle uses buttons 'EN' / 'BM' in the nav. Hero section uses id='top', not id='hero'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial failed assertion in first test pass was a test-script issue (using is_visible() on bullets clipped by overflow-hidden parent); rewrote check to use aria-expanded which correctly reflects open state.
